limits: Bounded Mac melonDS DS1.3.1 software/builtin-BIOS acceptance, isolated project progress. SS uses HG-derived progress; fresh story and universal save interchange are not proven.

Only nine new location/ball-supply bytes per game; declared source retains prior native-release VM/location fixture ancestry. Existing Repel is used through native UI; no Pokemon identity/HP/status/coordinates/EXP edits.

Early contact-chase branches are exploratory, not Raikou proof. Accepted lineage is field -> On/Off -> Few -> native Repel -> clear/regenerate -> rare navigation -> autonomous contact -> native Friend Ball throw. HG moves briefly into native wander bounds, SS waits without input in the auto phase.
On/Off enemy identity is identical within each game. Later RNG streams are not claimed identical: native catch success uses four requested rolls and failure one, with normal later behavior.
Instruction tests execute original native RNG, calculator and SDK division. Base-stat/type/mon services and square-root hardware are controlled; they do not establish actual special-format gameplay.

Supported Safari/contest/double/partner flag combinations and forbidden trainer/link/Frontier/unknown paths have instruction coverage. Broader ordinary/special battles, all balls, positive legendary status, full party/storage capacity and long-play acceptance remain pending.

Captured Raikou retains all 236 bytes across native save/cold. Lead raw byte change is exactly the original follower mood reset on registration; all reward fields remain identical. Read-only getters preserve their input bytes; the explanatory native setter runs only on a separate private RAM copy.
Other unfinished inventory work and broad integrated acceptance remain part of the full objective. This milestone is not a final release.
